VipInfo_Level: Bạn có thể mua vật phẩm này bằng cách nâng hạng cấp VIP của mình.
VipRules: VIP Guideline: VIP Levels: 47 VIP Exp will be rewarded by betting on Advantplay’s game. Your VIP level will be upgraded when the required Exp for each level is fulfilled. 1. VIP Exp The VIP Experience Points are accumulated based on the player's turnover on Advantplay’s game. ※VIP Exp is calculated based on Advantplay’s exchange rate. 2. Reward Point Reward Points can be used to purchase items in the AdvantPlay Store. They can be accumulated through the Daily Rebate feature and the Lucky Wheel. 3. Level Category 11 (Casual, Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Emerald, Sapphire, Black, Diamond, Purple Diamond, Red Diamond) 4. Level Progression Players progress through levels by earning VIP Experience Points, which are allocated based on the EXP achieved at each VIP level. 5. Level Duration The validity of a player's VIP level will be valid for one month commencing from the moment they attained the required VIP Experience Points for that specific level. To maintain a player's VIP Level, the reward system evaluates their experience points accumulated over the previous two months. Example: ※ When the cumulative VIP Experience Points reaches 2,000 on November 12, the VIP level will be upgraded from Casual to Bronze 1 and expires on November 31. ※ On January 1st, the system will determine the VIP Experience Points accumulated from November to December as 2,000, making it eligible for the Bronze 1 level. Therefore, the VIP level in January remains Bronze 1 and expires on January 31. ※ On February 1st, If the system determined the VIP Experience Points accumulated over December and January as 0 or below the VIP Experience Points required (2,000) to maintain as Bronze Level 1, the system will revert the VIP back to previous VIP level. Therefore, the VIP level in February will be Casual. VIP Privilege: Daily Rebate Description: First-ever rebate in AdvantPlay history Rebate Percentage: Up to 1% (from player’s bet) Rebate Calculation: The rebate percentage is intricately tied to the player's VIP Level. As players level up their VIP Level, they unlock higher rebate percentages, thus maximizing their gaming rewards. Eligibility: Available to players across all levels except for the 'Casual' level. Rebate Distribution: The rebate will be converted to Reward Points and distributed to players' accounts daily at 00:00:00 (GMT+0). Minimum Rebate: The minimum daily rebate distributed to players is 40 Reward Points (RP). ※Reward Point below 40 will not be credited to the player. Reward Usage: All rebates will be converted into Reward Points (RP), which can be used to purchase items from the AdvantPlay Store. Lucky Wheel Description: The Lucky Wheel offers players the chance to spin and win extra Reward Points, thereby accelerating their progress towards earning additional rewards. Prizes: Ranging from 20 Reward Points to maximum 800. Reward Points Extra Bonus: The extra bonus awarded from the Lucky Wheel can be up to 10%, depending on the player's VIP level. Weekly Acquisition: Each player‘s opportunity to receive Lucky Wheel tickets is capped weekly, based on their respective VIP levels. Reset Schedule: The maximum number of Lucky Wheel tickets a player can receive will be reset at the beginning of each week, specifically at 00:00:00 every Monday. Reward Usage: The Reward Points received from the Lucky Wheel can be used to purchase items in the Store.
